name: Castleinch
bedsNote: All three bedrooms are on the ground floor (single storey)
heating: Solid-fuel stove only (range-style cooker in the kitchen)
tagline: A single-storey country cottage on about an acre of mature garden on the Callan road, roughly 5 km from Kilkenny city.

pros.detail: Stamp duty about €3,500, leaving room for an extension.
All three bedrooms and the shower room are on the ground floor, so any bedroom works for the parents.

pros.text: About an acre of mature garden
pros.detail: Roughly 0.4 ha with garage and shed; meets the dog brief.
St Luke's, Kilkenny (24-hour ED) and Kilkenny city are about 5–6 km away.
Church Hill NS, Cuffesgrange, about 192 pupils.
Kilkenny MacDonagh station about 10 minutes away, then about 1h30 to Heuston.
Listed as turnkey, with timber floors and a range in the kitchen.
St Kieran's College (boys, 100% to third level in 2023), CBS Kilkenny and Kilkenny College (mixed) are all a short drive.

cons.text: About 94 m², just under the 100 m² floor
cons.detail: The listing's '1,015 m²' reads as 1,015 sq ft ≈ 94 m². A modest extension (~20–40 m², rough €50–100k) would make room for visiting parents.

cons.text: BER F, only a stove listed
cons.detail: The sitting-room stove is the only heat source named ('range-style cooker' is a cooker). Heating and insulation retrofit a rough €40-70k before grants.
A single shower room for a family plus summering parents.
Listed as 'just off the main Callan Road': check whether the gate is on the N76 or a side road, the traffic noise, and dog-proof frontage.
Ask about mains or well, septic and broadband.

trips.note: 192 pupils, Catholic, co-ed, roll 05927L; ~2.5 km. Claims to be Ireland's oldest functioning school (1833).

rating.basis: Catholic co-ed school, not DEIS, with steady enrolment, a special-class 'Sunflower Rooms' and an on-site pre-school; no inspection report retrieved.

trips.note: Boys only, ~830 pupils, non-fee-paying; ~4 km straight line. Nearer Presentation (3.8 km) is girls-only.

rating.basis: 100% progression to third level in the 2023 feeder-school report (Kilkenny People/Irish Independent); large, non-fee-paying, not DEIS.

ai.why: Single storey on an acre, 10 minutes from Kilkenny's hospital and schools. About 94 m², BER F, stove only.

water.detail: Unknown; not stated (rural, could be a well)

internet.detail: Fibre likely but not stated in the listing: NBI had passed 98.9% of Kilkenny's intervention-area premises by March 2026, and houses this close to the city may instead be on Eir's own rural FTTH. Confirm by Eircode.
